adminApiKey.description: BOT_ADMIN_KEY, sent as Authorization: Bearer <BOT_ADMIN_KEY>. Admin JWT from /api/v1/auth/admin/token is also accepted.

servers.description: List of server locations to include

followers.description: Number of followers on social media

nickname.description: Partner nickname (English letters, digits, _ only, no spaces or special chars)

cleanup_traffic_exhausted.description: Clean up users who exhausted their traffic

user_id.description: User ID to clear abuse status

websocket.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time user notifications. Connect with user_id path parameter.

WebSocket endpoint for admin connections. Authentication is performed via the `Authorization: Bearer <BOT_ADMIN_KEY>` header (recommended). The `{admin_key}` path parameter is DEPRECATED and will be removed in a future release; do not use it in new clients.

parameters.name: admin_key
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: pass BOT_ADMIN_KEY in the Authorization header instead.

get.description: Public endpoint to check API availability. No authentication required.
System statistics: total users, subscribers, partners.
Public panel status information including server status and nodes. Returns only fields required for public rendering.
Public endpoint. Returns all active tariffs from the catalog (tarifs.json).

post.description: Создание веб-аккаунта по логину и паролю.
Аутентификация по логину и паролю. Возвращает токен сессии.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile as a flat SanitizedUser object (same contract as /api/v1/profile).

post.description: Invalidate the current session token.
Смена пароля для авторизации по логину и паролю.

Link a Telegram user ID to the current web account. Requires a valid Telegram verification state created by /api/v1/auth/telegram/link-start. Returns 403 if state is missing, expired, or tg_id does not match the verified state. Returns 409 if Telegram is already linked to another account.
Create a one-time state token for bot-assisted login. State is valid for 5 minutes (TTL=300). Returns a Telegram deep-link URL to open in the bot.
Create a state token for linking Telegram to a web account via bot. Requires authentication. Returns a Telegram deep-link URL.

get.description: Poll the status of a Telegram authentication state created by /api/v1/auth/telegram/start or /api/v1/auth/telegram/link-start.

get.summary: Get feature flags and public configuration
get.description: Returns public feature flags, available payment methods, and public links.
Returns all users that have a non-empty abuse_status field.

post.summary: Clear abuse status for a user
post.description: Resets the abuse_status field for the specified user, sends notification to user, and optionally recreates their subscription.

Create a payment session. Generates a payment_id and returns a payment URL (Yoomoney) or card payment details. Price is recalculated server-side (trust discount applied, custom plan price computed from parameters). Order ID is unique per request.

get.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile. Returns a flat SanitizedUser object with subscription, referrals, partner info, and trust score data.

patch.description: Update the current user's interface language preference.

language.description: Language code (e.g. ru, en, pl, zh)

post.description: Creates a pending payment request for a catalog tariff. The subscription itself is NOT granted immediately: an administrator must confirm the payment in the Telegram bot. The tariff is resolved server-side from the catalog and the trust discount is applied to the amount. Trust score is only accrued after the administrator confirms the payment.

Creates a pending payment request to renew a subscription with a catalog tariff. The subscription is NOT extended immediately: an administrator must confirm the payment in the Telegram bot, which then renews the existing subscription or creates one if it is no longer active. The tariff is resolved server-side from the catalog and the trust discount is applied to the amount. Trust score is only accrued after the administrator confirms the payment.
Activate a trial (free) subscription. Only available for users without an active subscription.

Creates a request for a test subscription for the administrator account. The request goes through the same approval flow as a regular payment: it is stored as a pending request (plan_type = "test") and the subscription is issued only after an administrator confirms it. Works for catalog plans and for a custom plan (plan_id = "custom" with custom_plan). The test subscription is stored separately from the canonical Admin subscription and never overwrites its sub_id.

get.description: Returns the VPN link and JSON link for an active subscription. vpn_url and json_vpn_url are empty strings when the corresponding subscription base URL is not configured on the bot; clients must hide the link block in that case instead of rendering a bare subscription id.

post.description: Add extra traffic (GB) to an active subscription.

get.description: Public endpoint to verify the validity of a subscription by subscription ID.
Public endpoint. Returns a list of available server locations with flags and labels.
Returns public partner program configuration: commission percent, requirements, terms URL, period limits, bonus days, and trust points.
Get partner account information: balance, commission, referrals, referral code and referral link.

post.description: Submit an application to join the partner program. Requires authentication. Nickname must contain only English letters, digits and _. Consent to the partner terms is collected once on the requirements screen before the application form starts, so no consent flag is sent here. Creates a pending partner_new operation for admin review and returns both app_id and operation_id.

get.description: Returns whether the authenticated user has a pending partner application.

post.description: Request a renewal of the partner agreement. Renewal is free of charge: no payment record is created and no amount is charged, and a pending subscription payment does not block it. Creates a pending partner_renewal operation for admin review. The partnership expiry and the panel client expiry are extended when the admin accepts the operation.
Request a withdrawal from the partner balance via SBP (System of Instant Payments). Requires fio, phone, and bank for the withdrawal.
Calculate the cost of a custom plan with traffic, IP, and duration parameters. Requires authentication.

get.description: Returns bounds and coefficients for generating custom tariffs. Requires authentication (user/admin session, BOT_API_KEY, BOT_ADMIN_KEY, or admin JWT).
Detailed partner statistics: referrals, payouts, bonuses.
Referral program statistics: total referrals, paying referrals, referral link.

post.description: Clean up expired records: expired subscriptions, exhausted traffic, missing clients. Supports dry-run mode.

get.description: Search users by query for debugging purposes. Requires admin rights (admin session, BOT_ADMIN_KEY, or admin JWT).
Detailed system health check including users, payments, and partner operations. Requires admin rights (admin session, BOT_ADMIN_KEY, or admin JWT).

post.description: Send a personal message to a user via Telegram bot.
Add or remove extra IPs on the user subscription. Updates the database and syncs limitIp on the panel. Admin users and users without an active subscription are rejected.

delta.description: Relative change, positive to add IPs, negative to remove

403.description: Admin required or target is admin
